title: phpgraph outline --format json
description: The structural outline of a feature, or of what one method runs. Stable from 2.1.0: keys are only added, in a minor version; read it ignoring the keys you do not know. Ids are graph.json node ids. A map is always a JSON object, {} when empty.

seeds.description: The classes the topic names, the outline starts from them.

core.description: The classes of the feature, in the order they joined.

sourcesRead.description: Whether the sources could be read: without them, the core classes carry their id and reason only.

families.description: Interfaces and base classes around the core.

routes.description: The routes running into the core.

chain.description: The methods from the route's handler down into the core.

operations.description: The API schema operations the route implements.
Operation id => the core method implementing it (gRPC).

entries.description: Method of the core => the methods outside the core calling it.

fromFamilies.description: Method of the core => family head => its members' methods calling it.

closures.description: Method of the core => the method writing a closure it runs => what the closure calls.

inside.description: Method of the core => the methods of other core classes it calls.

hints.description: Behaviour read in the method bodies: guarded throws, early returns, branches on constants.

method.description: The method name, without its class.

consumers.description: Application class outside the core => its links to it.

tests.description: Test module => test files touching the core.

topTests.description: The test files touching the most core classes.

unused.description: Core classes nothing in the application uses.

method.description: When the topic names a method: that method, the core is what it runs.

depths.description: With a method: the methods it runs => calls away from it.

hubs.description: With a method: the hubs it reaches, not followed => application classes calling them.

guesses.description: With a method: the calls guessed from a unique method name (AMBIGUOUS), caller => callees.

guessed.description: With a method: the methods it reaches only through such guesses.

large.description: When the class named declares many methods: its entry points, to outline one by one.

entries.description: Method => the routes handled by it and the classes calling it.

left.description: When the core is full: the classes that qualified after it, best first.

leftReasons.description: Class left out => why it qualified.

reason.description: Why a class is in the outline.

kind.description: Seeds: named (the topic names the class), route (it handles a route named after the topic), topic (its name or namespace carries the topic's words), method (one of its methods does). Joined: module (of a seed's module), uses (it uses a core class), used_by (a core class uses it), family (an interface or base class whose members mostly use the core). A method's outline: start (the class of the method), called (called by a method it runs).

via.description: The class, method or route the decision went through.

count.description: For a family, its members using the core.

reduced.description: A class used by many, shown with the methods the core calls only.

summary.description: The first sentence of its docblock.

cases.description: Enum case => value as written, or ''.

properties.description: Property naming another core class => its type as written.
